title: Lead Protocol handoff
description: Canonical JSON representation of .agents/local/<actor>/<agent>/handoff.md. The markdown file is the source of truth for humans; this schema validates the parsed structure for tooling (CLI, pre-commit hooks, CI validators). Starting in Lead Protocol v2.0.0, each (actor, agent) pair has its own handoff.md under .agents/local/<actor>/<agent>/.

version.description: Handoff file version (X.Y or X.Y.Z). Independent from Protocol version.

last_agent.description: Agent signature in square brackets, e.g. '[Claude Code / claude-opus-4-7]'. A pristine template may use '[Your Agent Signature]' as a placeholder — tooling must treat any value containing 'Your Agent Signature' as an uninitialized handoff.

timestamp.description: Session close timestamp in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' format. HH:MM is mandatory (not just the date) so takeover rules can compute elapsed minutes.

status.description: Three-state operational status. See §P3 for definitions.

last_action.description: One-sentence description of what the last session accomplished.

pending_step.description: What the next agent should do. Use 'None' when the state is terminal/stable.

blockers_context.description: Current blockers or relevant context. Use 'None' when there are no blockers.

open_threads.description: Unrelated pending items that deserve later attention. Use 'None' when empty. Free-form markdown (typically a bullet list).

session_close_checklist.description: Self-verified checkboxes required by §P3. Eight items in v2.0.0 (added journal_appended for the procedural JOURNAL promotion question).

checked.description: True when the agent checked the box. A session cannot close with unchecked boxes unless explicitly marked N/A.

na.description: Set to true when the item does not apply to this session. An item marked N/A still counts as resolved.

note.description: Optional inline explanation. In markdown this appears as a trailing '— <note>' after the checkbox.
